## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and compatibility impact.

## Evidence

- [ ] Deterministic tests added or updated
- [ ] Raw data is preserved and smoothing is labelled
- [ ] Uncertainty and missing evidence are explicit
- [ ] Predicted response is not presented as measured verification

## Mutation safety

- [ ] Read-only, or preview/confirmation/backup/verify/rollback are tested
- [ ] Audible output retains fresh physical-readiness and protection guards
- [ ] No personal measurements, paths, routes, serials, or room data are included

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run coverage`
- [ ] `npm run validate:release`
